subject: history
concept: Understanding the spread and historical influence of major world religions and philosophies
source_inspiration: original content, presented factually and respectfully per the Education Conduct Policy — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student traces the geographic spread of a belief system on a simplified world map over time
exercise.abstract: Student explains one way a described belief system influenced the societies it spread to

misconception_flags: presents a belief system's history inaccurately or disrespectfully rather than factually

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
